projects.title: Wintercubetimer
bullets: Built a C# WinForms Rubik's Cube timer, designing session tracking, scramble generation and a real-time cube visualization across 43 files.
Iterated on the cube-visualization rendering after early versions felt disorienting during fast solves, adjusting animation timing for clearer feedback.

projects.title: Lazaropenglengine3d
bullets: Wrote a pseudo-3D game engine in C++ and OpenGL, structuring rendering and scene logic across 905 files.
Explored low-level graphics programming independently, building comfort with the rendering pipeline outside coursework.

leadership.title: Cabinet Restoration Volunteer
bullets: Repaired aging arcade cabinets with mismatched CRT timings, learning to diagnose display issues before touching any code.
Gave a short walkthrough to newer members on how raster displays render frames, translating hardware quirks into plain language.
